import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Mod {
        int num;

        Mod() {
            this(0);
        }

        Mod(long n) {
            num = (int) ((n % 1000000007 + 1000000007) % 1000000007);
        }

        Mod(int n) {
            this((long) n);
        }

        int getNum() {
            return num;
        }

        Mod operatorPlus(Mod b) {
            return new Mod((num + b.num) % 1000000007);
        }

        Mod operatorPlus(long b) {
            return new Mod(num + b);
        }

        Mod operatorPlus(int b) {
            return new Mod((long) b + num);
        }

        Mod operatorMinus(Mod b) {
            return new Mod((1000000007 + num - b.num) % 1000000007);
        }

        Mod operatorMinus(long b) {
            return new Mod(num - b);
        }

        Mod operatorMinus(int b) {
            return new Mod((long) b - num);
        }

        Mod operatorTimes(Mod b) {
            return new Mod(((long) num * b.num) % 1000000007);
        }

        Mod operatorTimes(long b) {
            return new Mod(b * num);
        }

        Mod operatorTimes(int b) {
            return new Mod((long) b * num);
        }

        Mod operatorDivide(Mod b) {
            return new Mod(num * inv(b));
        }

        Mod operatorDivide(long b) {
            return new Mod(num / b);
        }

        Mod operatorDivide(int b) {
            return new Mod((long) b / num);
        }

        Mod operatorPow(int n) {
            if (n == 0) return new Mod(1);
            Mod res = (this * this).pow(n / 2);
            if (n % 2 == 1) res = res * this;
            return res;
        }

        Mod inv() {
            return pow(1000000007 - 2);
        }

        Mod pow(int n) {
            if (n == 0) return new Mod(1);
            Mod res = pow((this * this), n / 2);
            if (n % 2 == 1) res = res * this;
            return res;
        }
    }

    static class FastScanner {
        BufferedReader br;
        StringTokenizer st;

        public FastScanner() {
            br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        }

        String next() {
            while (st == null || !st.hasMoreElements()) {
                try {
                    st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
                } catch (IOException e) {
                    e.printStackTrace();
                }
            }
            return st.nextToken();
        }

        int nextInt() {
            return Integer.parseInt(next());
        }

        long nextLong() {
            return Long.parseLong(next());
        }

        double nextDouble() {
            return Double.parseDouble(next());
        }

        String nextLine() {
            String str = "";
            try {
                str = br.readLine();
            } catch (IOException e) {
                e.printStackTrace();
            }
            return str;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        FastScanner scanner = new FastScanner();
        PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(System.out);

        int N = scanner.nextInt();
        int s = 3 - (N + 1) / 2;
        Mod[][] pers = new Mod[6][6];
        for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 6; j++) {
                pers[i][j] = new Mod(scanner.nextInt());
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < s; i++) {
            pers[i][i] = new Mod(1);
        }
        for (int i = s; i < s + N; i++) {
            for (int j = s; j < s + N; j++) {
                pers[i][j] = new Mod(scanner.nextInt());
            }
        }
        for (int i = s + N; i < 6; i++) {
            pers[i][i] = new Mod(1);
        }

        Mod[] u_nums = solve(pers, 0);
        Mod[] d_nums = solve(pers, 3);
        for (int x = 1; x < (1 << 20); x <<= 1) {
            for (int i = 0; i < (1 << 20); i++) {
                if ((i & x) == 0) {
                    d_nums[i ^ x] = d_nums[i].operatorPlus(d_nums[i ^ x]);
                }
            }
        }
        Mod answer = new Mod(0);
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << 20); i++) {
            if (u_nums[i].getNum() != 0) {
                int need = 0;
                for (int x = 0; x < 20; x++) {
                    if ((i & (1 << x)) != 0) {
                        need |= (1 << (19 - x));
                    }
                }
                int pp = ((1 << 20) - 1) ^ i;
                Mod nanswer = u_nums[i].operatorTimes(new Mod(1).operatorMinus(d_nums[pp]));
                answer = answer.operatorPlus(nanswer);
            }
        }
        out.println(answer.getNum());
        out.close();
    }

    static Mod[] solve(Mod[][] pers, int al) {
        Mod[] l_nums = new Mod[1 << 20];
        for (int xx = 0; xx < (1 << 18); xx++) {
            boolean[][] haves = new boolean[3][6];
            Mod per = new Mod(1);
            for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < 6; j++) {
                    int k = i * 6 + j;
                    if ((xx & (1 << k)) != 0) {
                        haves[i][j] = true;
                        per = per.operatorTimes(pers[al + i][j]);
                    } else {
                        per = per.operatorTimes(new Mod(1).operatorMinus(pers[al + i][j]));
                    }
                }
            }
            int flags = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
                if (!haves[0][i]) continue;
                for (int j = 0; j < 6; j++) {
                    if (!haves[1][j]) continue;
                    if (i == j) continue;
                    for (int k = 0; k < 6; k++) {
                        if (!haves[2][k]) continue;
                        if (i == k) continue;
                        if (j == k) continue;
                        else {
                            int anum = 0;
                            anum ^= (1 << i);
                            anum ^= (1 << j);
                            anum ^= (1 << k);
                            flags |= (1 << mp.get(anum));
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            l_nums[flags] = per;
        }
        return l_nums;
    }

    static Map<Integer, Integer> mp = new HashMap<>();
    static {
        int id = 0;
        int[] v = new int[3];
        do {
            int tt = 0;
            for (int k = 0; k < 6; k++) {
                if (v[k] != 0) tt ^= (1 << k);
            }
            mp.put(tt, id);
            id++;
        } while (nextPermutation(v));
    }

    static boolean nextPermutation(int[] v) {
        int i = v.length - 2;
        while (i >= 0 && v[i + 1] <= v[i]) i--;
        if (i < 0) return false;
        int j = v.length - 1;
        while (v[j] <= v[i]) j--;
        swap(v, i, j);
        int left = i + 1;
        int right = v.length - 1;
        while (left < right) {
            swap(v, left, right);
            left++;
            right--;
        }
        return true;
    }

    static void swap(int[] v, int i, int j) {
        int temp = v[i];
        v[i] = v[j];
        v[j] = temp;
    }
}
